title: DisarmTrailRequest
description: Update payload for PositionWorkflow.disarm_trail (#825) — the operator lever that removes an armed trailing stop WITHOUT closing the position, so its basis can be re-anchored (the #820 runbook order: disarm → correct_booked_lot → re-arm; armTrail is deliberately idempotent and will never re-anchor an armed trail). Disarming removes real-money downside protection: the reason is mandatory and the TrailDisarmed audit row PAGES. An Update, not a signal — a refusal (nothing armed) must be reported, and the synchronous answer carries the prior stop so the operator knows exactly what protection was just removed. The premium-tick subscription is left running (no unsubscribe activity exists; ticks are ignored while disarmed and a re-arm reuses the stream).

operator_id.description: The operator disarming; recorded as actor operator:<id> on the paged TrailDisarmed audit row.

reason.description: Why protection is being removed (e.g. 'disarm-correct-rearm, #820 heal'). Mandatory; recorded verbatim.
